jobTitle: Senior Program Manager. Long Term Planning, Supply Chain Mexico
jobTitleRaw: Sr. Program Manager. Long Term Planning, Supply Chain Mexico

locations.address: Mexico City, Cuauhtémoc, Mexico City, Mexico

requirementsSummary: The candidate should have 5+ years of program or project management experience, with a strong background in data-driven decision making, stakeholder management, and project execution

companyData.description_summary:
Amazon is a global leader in e-commerce, retail, and cloud computing, dedicated to being the most customer-centric company in the world. The company offers a vast online marketplace, innovative digital content, and cutting-edge cloud services through Amazon Web Services (AWS), serving millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. 

Amazon fosters a dynamic, fast-paced environment focused on invention and operational excellence. Professionals joining Amazon contribute to groundbreaking technologies like Alexa, while upholding a commitment to long-term thinking and a unique 'Day 1' mentality – prioritizing agility, innovation, and customer delight.

descriptionText:
Role Overview
The Sr Manager will play a critical role in ensuring the coordination of our Long Term Planning Cycles and that projects are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget, while aligning with our business goals.
What You Will Do
Coordinate cross-functional teams, lead strategical conversations, plan and monitor multiple projects, develop and maintain project schedules, budgets and resource plans, and provide regular status updates and reports to stakeholders.
Why It Might Be a Fit
The role requires strong leadership, exceptional communication skills, and deep understanding of e-commerce's supply chain.
Requirements
• 5+ years of program or project management experience
• Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
• Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
• Bachelor's degree
• 3+ years of managing stakeholders in cross-functional project experience
• Experience in project management including resource planning, managing schedules, reporting project status and prioritizing tasks
• Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above

Benefits
• Dental insurance
• Vision insurance
• Health insurance
• Retirement plan
• Paid time off
• Flexible work arrangements

jobTitle: Shift Area Manager, Last Mile Operations
jobTitleRaw: Shift Area Manager, Last Mile Operations
requirementsSummary: The candidate should have a bachelor's degree or 2+ years of Amazon experience, 2+ years of direct management experience, and 3+ years of general experience

companyData.description_summary:
Amazon is a global leader in e-commerce, retail, and cloud computing, dedicated to being the most customer-centric company in the world. The company offers a vast online marketplace, innovative digital content, and cutting-edge cloud services through Amazon Web Services (AWS), serving millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. 

Amazon fosters a dynamic, fast-paced environment focused on invention and operational excellence. Professionals joining Amazon contribute to groundbreaking technologies like Alexa, while upholding a commitment to long-term thinking and a unique 'Day 1' mentality – prioritizing agility, innovation, and customer delight.

descriptionText:
Role Overview
As a Shift Area Manager, you will be responsible for the day-to-day management of the delivery station, overseeing the operation that focuses on the delivery of Amazon orders direct to customers. You will lead a team of Process Assistants and Delivery Service Providers in daily management of the delivery station, including meetings, training sessions, assigning job duties, and communicating with DSPs including management representatives and their drivers.
What You Will Do
Your main activities will include reviewing operational forecasts, determining productivity requirements, managing a team to meet building goals, supporting safety programs, and proactively identifying and leading process improvement initiatives. You will also be responsible for ensuring a safe work environment, properly training people, and addressing their needs so they can focus on their jobs.
Why It Might Be a Fit
We are looking for someone who is able to adapt to sudden changes and growth according to operational necessities. You should be able to lead change at internet speed and have experience managing teams of 20 people or greater.
Requirements
• Speak, write, and read fluently in Spanish
• Speak, write, and read fluently in English
• Bachelor's degree, or 2+ years of Amazon experience
• 2+ years of direct management experience
• 3+ years of general experience
• Flexibility to work weekends and/or overnight shifts if needed
• Availability to work 50% of the time on a night shift

descriptionText:
Role Overview
An experienced supply chain professional with a passion to innovate and contribute in a fast-paced growing environment is required. The Inbound Supply Chain Manager acts as a bridge between business and operations teams, responsible for seamless long-term planning of inbound freight into our network, maximizing vendor and seller experience.
What You Will Do
Set up processes to strengthen inbound supply chain planning, own long-term planning for WePay/PCP inbound programs, make existing processes scalable by identifying and implementing available tools/automation, rollout best practices from other geographies/companies to minimize end-to-end supply chain losses, and utilize exceptional problem-solving and communication skills to influence business, operations, and technical audiences.
Why It Might Be a Fit
Candidates should exhibit detail-oriented skills, analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, excellent communication skills, and a strong customer focus. The role demands strong program management skills, and the ability to drive data-driven discussions.
Requirements
• 2+ years of program or project management experience
• 3+ years of Computerized Maintenance Management System program experience
• 3+ years of maintenance planner/scheduler in industrial maintenance, manufacturing, or distribution industries experience
• 3+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
